html:
This page is a clone of the bot command $$tutorial. If you'd like more detailed information and tips on "How to Play", check out the FAQ

Thanks for trying out IdleCorp! If you need help from our community or want to trade with other players, join our Discord server at https://discordapp.com/invite/N9CH9wV

Contents

  • 1 Building a facility
  • 2 Managing your assets
  • 3 Regions
  • 4 There's more!

Building a facility[edit]

Facilities will produce assets which you can sell for money!
- You can build new facilities with the $$build command. Try building a tree farm with
$$build tree farm
- You can build multiple at a time like this:
$$build tree farm 5
- Eventually, you'll have enough wood to build an iron mine
- You can see a list of your facilities with $$f
- You can see a list of all facilities you can build with $$faclist

Managing your assets[edit]

Assets are used by some facilities to manufacture new assets, or can be sold either to NPCs or to other players.
- You can check your current assets with $$a
- If you want to sell all of your wood, you can use
$$sa wood
- If you want to buy some asset, iron for example, you can use
$$buy iron
- Once you've sold some assets, you can check your capital and other stats with
$$c
- You can check the current price of an asset like crude oil with
$$price oil
- You can get a list of the current prices of all assets with $$price

Regions[edit]

Each Discord Server is its own IdleCorp region where your corporation stores assets and builds facilities.
- Assets that are produced in one region can only be accessed in that region (until you export them)
- However, your corporation's money or capital is shared between all regions.
- Each region also has its own production modifiers, services, and policies.
You can check these with $$r

There's more![edit]

There's a ton more to IdleCorp that will take too long to explain now!
- There's a research system with random blueprints to be discovered,
- A purely player-driven market that you can trade in,
- Daily challenges to complete for your Season Pass,
- Regional policies and legislation that you can participate in,
and so much more!
- Check out all commands with $$commands
